**Implementation note:** The call leg of ThetaGang's wheel; options are out of scope.

## Description

Hold the underlying and sell calls to collect premium, accepting capped upside above the strike.

## Where it may fit

Flat to moderately rising markets and investors prioritizing premium income over full upside capture.

## Vehicles

Equity-income funds, buy-write ETFs, index option overlays.

## Required data

Underlying price/total returns, call chain, strike/expiry, implied volatility, dividends, assignment and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Premium is compensation for selling upside, not free yield; sharp rallies can underperform long-only holdings.
